cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: CWE-942 specifically addresses cross-domain security policies (CSP, cross-domain.xml) allowing untrusted domains. The demonstrated behavior is disabling a developer tools setting, not configuring domain permissions.

connection.evidence: No evidence of cross-domain communication, untrusted domains, or security policy configuration. The setting controls developer tools availability, not domain permissions.

diff_causality.evidence: The patch adds explicit disabling of DeveloperExtrasEnabled in footnote view. If reverted, developer tools would potentially be enabled in footnote view.

security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-942 requires controls to validate and restrict which domains are allowed in cross-domain policies
existing_controls_checked: DeveloperExtrasEnabled setting (controls developer tools, not domain permissions)
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No cross-domain policy configuration or validation is demonstrated; the setting change is unrelated to domain security

concrete_impact.evidence: No evidence of cross-domain communication vulnerabilities. Developer tools availability does not directly relate to CWE-942's cross-domain policy issues.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, DeveloperExtrasEnabled would potentially be enabled in footnote view, allowing developer tools access in that context.
supporting_evidence: Explicit setting of DeveloperExtrasEnabled to False in footnote view initialization
contradicting_evidence: No cross-domain policy configuration or domain permissions are demonstrated
DeveloperExtrasEnabled controls developer tools, not cross-domain security policies
unresolved_facts: Whether main document view has DeveloperExtrasEnabled enabled
Actual security impact of the setting disparity
Whether footnote content involves cross-domain communication
